pass.answer: Boris runs 3-5 Claude Code sessions at once, each in its own git worktree, so their edits never collide.
Spin up three to five sessions; start each with `claude --worktree` so every one gets its own checkout.

fail.answer: Open several terminal tabs and run claude in each one.
Give each parallel session its own git worktree.
fail.why: worktrees without the 3-5 count from the tips

fail.answer: Boris runs 3-5 sessions in separate terminal tabs.
